name: Nico
self_text: Hi! I'm Nico, an Australian in my late 20s. When I'm not gaming, I love swing dancing because the energy and music always put me in a great mood. I play on PC and mainly spend my time in Hollow Lantern. I usually queue for ranked matches and I play a damage role. In terms of communication, I use either text chat or voice chat. I'm not looking for any coaching, but I am free to play on Saturday morning or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday morning or Sunday morning. You have to play a damage role or be flexible about your role, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are into ranked matches. It would be nice if you are into Hollow Lantern, but no big deal.
